DesignLibrary 0.1 designers not ported as-is

Source: R/designers.R
designers-not-ported.Rd

These names exist so that code written for DesignLibrary 0.1 fails with an error that says what to write instead, rather than with "object not found" or, worse, several lines later on a NULL design. Each names the related declarations available through make_design(), for example make_design("encouragement") or make_design("factorial_2x2").

Usage

binary_iv_designer(...)

cluster_sampling_designer(...)

factorial_designer(...)

process_tracing_designer(...)

regression_discontinuity_designer(...)

spillover_designer(...)

two_arm_covariate_designer(...)

Arguments

...

Ignored.

Value

Nothing: these always stop.

See also

make_design()
